description: Returns the Wall Street Money Index (WSMI): a 0–100 reading of how institutional money moves into crypto through three channels — spot crypto ETFs (CEFI, 50%), stablecoins (30%) and tokenized real-world assets (20%). Each channel has its own 0–100 index scored against its past year; when a channel has no reading, the other weights are rescaled. 50 = neutral. Includes the current value, its change, the value a week and a month ago, the three channel indexes and the last 30 days. Zones: 0–20 extreme fear, 20–40 fear, 40–60 neutral, 60–80 greed, 80–100 extreme greed.
name: get_wsmi_index
title: Wall Street Money Index
